SASBDB entry SASDM96  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDM96/)

Publication: Long promoter sequences form higher-order G-quadruplexes: an integrative structural biology study of c-Myc, k-Ras and c-Kit promoter sequences.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkac182

Model and fit used as deposited. Script: test/fitting_tests/SASDM96/ cites the buffer
(BPEK) from the SASBDB entry and the paper.
Buffer (2026-11-13, papers are the source of truth): the paper (Monsen et al., NAR 2022) states BPEK
potassium phosphate, 185 mM KCl, 1 mM EDTA, pH 7.2, 22 C, 1.033 A; the script uses potassium
phosphates (6 mM K2HPO4 + 2 mM KH2PO4, SASBDB concentrations) instead of the SASBDB sodium salts.
